settingsEmailMarketing.title: Email Infrastructure
settingsEmailMarketing.description: Sending domains, providers and subscription categories for outbound email.
settingsEmailMarketing.noWorkspaceDetail: Pick a workspace to manage its email infrastructure.

domains.description: Domains you send from, their DNS verification, and warming schedules.
domains.emptyDetail: Add a domain and verify its DNS records before your first campaign goes out.

providers.description: The services that actually deliver your mail — SES, SendGrid, SMTP.
providers.emptyDetail: A provider is what actually delivers the mail. Without one, campaigns cannot send.

categories.description: Subscription categories let recipients choose which kinds of email they want.
categories.emptyDetail: Categories let recipients unsubscribe from one kind of email without leaving the rest.
